title: Nuevo Laredo Invests 8.9 Million Pesos in Paving and Lighting Across Four Colonias
excerpt: The government of Nuevo Laredo has delivered 8.9 million pesos in new public works across four colonias, pairing street lighting with fresh pavement, sidewalks,
content:
The government of Nuevo Laredo has delivered 8.9 million pesos in new public works across four colonias, pairing street lighting with fresh pavement, sidewalks, curbs and renewed water and sewer lines.

Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal delivered the works on Tuesday, Nov. 24, in the colonias San Roberto, Ejido La Unión, 150 Aniversario and Vamos Tamaulipas. In total, the projects add 1,354 linear meters of new street lighting and more than 2,300 square meters of asphalt paving, along with new sidewalks, curbs and signage.

The centerpiece is new lighting along Radial 3, between Carretera Aeropuerto and the Rotonda El Conejo, a stretch that links San Roberto and Ejido La Unión and serves as a strategic corridor for freight operators headed to the World Trade Bridge. City officials say the lighting and paving are meant to improve mobility and road safety in fast-growing neighborhoods on the city’s south side.

In other Nuevo Laredo news this week, the city’s voluntary disarmament campaign, “Sí al desarme, sí a la paz,” destroyed 83 firearms of various calibers and 2,748 cartridges at an event at Plaza Hidalgo, with residents who turned in weapons receiving 273,000 pesos in incentives. And DIF Nuevo Laredo, led by Liliana Canturosas Villarreal, will offer free services on Friday, Nov. 27, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Centro DIF Central, including medical, psychological and legal consultations, vaccinations, dentistry and haircuts.

Sources: Gobierno Municipal de Nuevo Laredo, Nov. 24, 2026; Hoy Tamaulipas, Nov. 25, 2026; Nube Tamaulipas, Nov. 24, 2026.
